def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    guy_patches = image_patch.find("guy")
    hand_patches = image_patch.find("hand")
    
    if not guy_patches or not hand_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    guy_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2, (p.upper + p.lower) / 2 for p in guy_patches]
    hand_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2, (p.upper + p.lower) / 2 for p in hand_patches]
    
    closest_hand = min(hand_centers, key=lambda h: sum((h[i] - g[i]) ** 2 for i in range(2)))
    closest_guy = min(guy_centers, key=lambda g: sum((g[i] - h[i]) ** 2 for i in range(2)))
    
    guy_idx = guy_centers.index(closest_guy)
    hand_idx = hand_centers.index(closest_hand)
    
    if abs(guy_idx - hand_idx) <= 1:
        return guy_patches[guy_idx]
    
    return image_patch

def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    guy_patches = image_patch.find("guy")
    if not guy_patches:
        return image_patch
    guy_patches.sort(key=lambda p: p.horizontal_center)
    guy_patch = guy_patches[-1]
    hand_patches = guy_patch.find("hand")
    if not hand_patches:
        return guy_patch
    hand_patches.sort(key=lambda p: p.vertical_center)
    hand_patch = hand_patches[0]
    hip_patches = guy_patch.find("hip")
    if not hip_patches:
        return hand_patch
    hip_patches.sort(key=lambda p: p.vertical_center)
    hip_patch = hip_patches[0]
    if hand_patch.overlaps_with(hand_patch.left, hand_patch.lower, hand_patch.right, hip_patch.upper):
        return hand_patch

            dy = abs(girl_center[1] - phone_center[1])
            distance = math.sqrt(dx**2 + dy**2)
            if distance < closest_distance:
                closest_distance = distance
                closest_phone = phone_patches[phone_centers.index(phone_center)]

    if len(object_patches) < 2:

    distances = [distance(a, b) for a, b in combinations(object_patches, 2)]
